title: Bryggebroen
scope: Closed-position Copenhagen harbour swing bridge with a tapered white steel spine, separate walking and cycling lanes, cable railings, splayed pipe bents, a concrete swing bearing, signal posts, and the projecting rust-colored fender system.
heightPolicy: The model uses a 1 m datum. The deck rises from 2.28 m at Havneholmen and 2.85 m at Islands Brygge to approximately 6.98 m. Height and swing bearing geometry are visual fits to the photos and standard terrain.
limitations: The mapped outline and path traces establish the crossing and landing positions. The visible supports, fenders, pivot and opening joints are proportioned from exterior photographs.

The deck grades approximate the harbour profile and the original Terrarium bank surfaces. The movable span is depicted in its closed position. The viewer review measures visual clearance and path continuity.
